content:
{
  "phoneNote": "The hero card obscures the dough in the photo, while repeated contact and opening-hours blocks make the lower page unnecessarily long.",
  "desktopNote": "The photographic hero and restrained palette work well, but oversized typography and sparse sections weaken the page’s rhythm and push the main action below the first screen.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 2,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 3
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 2,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 3
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Combine reservations, address, directions and opening hours into one contact section; retain only business and legal details in the footer.",
    "Recompose the phone hero so the dough remains visible above a more compact text card, and raise the desktop card enough to show its primary action within the first screen.",
    "Reduce the desktop heading and price sizes and tighten the menu and single-person team sections to remove oversized, underfilled bands."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "On both phone and desktop, the footer repeats the address, directions and opening-hours block immediately after the contact section."
  ]
}
